text: Hello boys and girls, welcome to my class.From today on, we will move on to unit 4, achievements.This is a reading and interaction, an accept from the old man and the sea.By the end of the lesson, you are expected toGain the main idea of the story, make sense of the scenes in the story, and explore the theme of the story.These are the pages that we'll read today.Have you got them ready?If so, let's get our class started.We'll be reading an accept from the old man and the sea.An accept is a short piece of writing or music, which is taken from a larger piece.Speaking of the old man and the sea, have you ever heard of its author, Ernest Hemingway?Ernest Hemingway is one of the most famous American writers of the 20th century.Hemingway was an ambulance driver in Italy during World War I.He returned to Europe to begin his career as a writer of fiction.For the next 40 years, he published numerous short stories and novels, among the most famous of which are The Sun Also Rises, A Farewell to Arms, For Whom the Bell Tolls, and The Old Man and the Sea.Though primarily known as a writer of fiction, he continued throughout his life to function as a journalist covering wars.Hemingway won the Pulitzer Prize in 1953 and the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1954 for his novel The Old Man and the Sea.There is no doubt that Ernest Hemingway made great achievements in literature and he was a successful writer.In your opinion, what may be defined as success?I'd like you to take a look at four quotes which are related to the definitions of success.Success is failing nine times and getting up ten.This sentence highlights the importance of never giving up if one wants to succeed.Success is being able to live your life in your own way.This sentence conveys the idea that your destiny is controlled by you and you alone.Take responsibility for your actions and their consequences and you'll find that you naturally become more successful.Luck is the best way to explain the success of people that you don't like, which means luck may play a small effect in every person's life, but it is not basic.The only way to accomplish a successful life is to work very hard.A successful person is someone who can build something with bricks that others have thrown at him.It tells us that if one wants to be successful, he should learn to stay focused on his own end goal and make a mindset shift to let negative feedback from others actually help him become stronger and better.No pain, no gain.We're very familiar with this sentence.It emphasizes that hard work matters the most in terms of achieving success.Definitions of success vary from person to person.Which quote appeals to you the most?Or do you have your own definition of success?The excerpt from The Old Man and the Sea we are going to read today also reveals what it takes to be successful.Let's read and find out.Now please scan the introduction and find more information about The Old Man and the Sea.While you are reading, please keep two questions in mind.Who is the main character in the story?And what happens to the main character?You will be given two minutes.Who is the main character of the story?It tells the story of an old man called a San Diego who goes out on the sea to fish.Therefore, an old man called a San Diego is the main character of the story.What happens to the main character?He has finally caught a huge fish after 84 days of catching nothing on the sea and ties the fish along the side of the boat.What can be the consequence of tying the huge fish along the side of the boat?The blood from the wounds of the big fish could attract sharks.The fish is likely to become the target of the attack.In other words, the fish is likely to become the objective of the attack of sharks.And the nightmare comes true.The passage begins at the moment when a large shark approaches the fish.Approaches the fish means a large shark comes near the fish.Can the old man survive a shark attack?Will he be able to fight off the bloodthirsty shark?Please skim the excerpt and find out.You'll be given two minutes.Time is up.The old man survived the shark's attack by killing it.Please scan the text and divide it into three parts based on the given main points.You'll be given one minute.Please scan the text and divide it into three parts.After the message of the
